abstract: Maintains regional connectivity indexes and public mass-transit capacity ratings
system_message:
You are the Municipal transit coordinator (TRANS), responsible for maintaining regional connectivity indexes and public mass-transit capacity ratings as well as monitoring taxi and rideshare staging throughput across venue options.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Taxi and rideshare staging（TAXI）
information_points.content:
TRANS-TAXI-3YC：At Kallang Riverside Expo Park, the passenger pickup berth throughput at the arrival concourse vehicle pick-up lanes is 180 vehicles/h in sustained clearance capacity.
TRANS-TAXI-FBR：At Jurong West Trade Hub, the passenger pickup berth throughput along the arrival concourse vehicle pick-up lanes is 300 vehicles/h in sustained clearance capacity.
TRANS-TAXI-EFZ：At Changi Maritime Exhibition Complex, the passenger pickup berth throughput across the arrival concourse vehicle pick-up lanes is 240 vehicles/h in sustained clearance capacity.

information_points.title: Maintains regional connectivity indexes and public mass-transit capacity ratings（CONX）
information_points.content:
TRANS-CONX-KQB：For Jurong West Trade Hub, the municipal transit passenger connectivity rating is 75 points within the pedestrian catchment of 400 m from the main registration concourse, accounting for heavy rail headways, bus line density, and station proximity.
TRANS-CONX-O68：For Changi Maritime Exhibition Complex, the municipal transit passenger connectivity rating is 72 points, measured across the 400 m pedestrian catchment around the main registration concourse using rail headways, bus route density, and station access.
TRANS-CONX-CP7：For Kallang Riverside Expo Park, the municipal transit passenger connectivity rating is 94 points, based on a pedestrian catchment within 400 m of the main registration concourse evaluating heavy rail headways, bus line density, and station proximity.
